tmp:2007: the forging of a combination (tzeruf) from the fallen sparks (nitzotzot) whereby a world is made — cosmogonic act of birur/rectification underlying strife's transformation
tmp:2008: the creation of a new heaven and new earth — cosmic renewal effected by praising God with strength from eating the true abundance that flows via the Land of Israel (per Zohar intro 5a, 'imi — My partner')
tmp:2009: the letters becoming shaped/configured (nitztayru ha-otiyot) — imprinting a form for good on the letters of speech so one's request is actualized
tmp:2010: becoming a vessel to receive good so one's request is filled in actuality — the state effected when will (desire) plus speech bring the soul from potential to act
tmp:2011: the ongoing action of searching out and gathering additional good points (nekudot tovot) within oneself despite their admixture with dross (Azamra practice, LM I:282)
tmp:2012: melodies (niggunim) being formed from the gathered good points — music arising from collecting the good spirit out of the depressed spirit (cf. LM I:54, playing on an instrument)
tmp:2013: ha-kissufin ve-ha-cheshek — holy yearning and desire to perform a mitzvah, the affective force that draws vowel points (nekudot) to the letters (wordplay: kissufin/kesef of 'nekudot ha-kasef')
tmp:2014: vowel points (nekudot) being formed — creation of the letters' vocalization through holy yearning (kissufin), per Song 1:11 'nekudot ha-kasef'
tmp:2015: 've-atzi'ah She'ol hinekha' (Ps. 139:8, 'if I bed in the abyss, You are there') — proof-verse for expertise in 'returning' (baki be-shov), the descent phase of teshuvah (aspect of ve-nafik, exiting)
tmp:2016: 've-dodi li' ('and my Beloved is mine,' Song 6:3) — mapped to ve-nafik/exiting, the 'expert in returning' pole of the run-and-return dynamic of teshuvah
tmp:2017: being severed from the rope of impurity and bound to the rope of holiness — the transfer of attachment effected through the sigh/groan (hevel of the mouth) of the penitent
tmp:2018: gan — 'garden' as symbol of the nefesh (soul), per Jer. 31:12 'their soul shall be like a watered garden,' the Gan of Gan Eden paired with Eden=ultimate purpose
tmp:2022: 'chasidekha' ('Your pious ones,' Ps. 145:10) — exegeted as the aspect of nefesh/soul, via Prov. 11:17 'a man of chesed benefits his own soul'
tmp:2023: the throne (kisse) on the level of nefesh — the 'concealed' (mekhusseh) soul-throne in the soul/ofanim/throne schema, i.e., the hidden precious soul of the sage
tmp:2024: nefesh he-chakham she-nitkasseh — the concealed soul of the wise man, hidden because of its preciousness (Prov. 3:15 'more precious than pearls,' cf. High Priest entering the innermost sanctum)
tmp:2025: the totality of her (the wife's/lower level's) nefesh-ruach-neshamah — the complete soul-complement of the feminine/lower rung, which counts as mere 'nefesh' relative to the man above it
tmp:2026: 'nefesh relative to him' — the relational status whereby an entire lower level (even with all three soul-parts) ranks as nefesh/feminine vis-à-vis the level above it
tmp:2027: 'yehalekhun' ('they walk,' from the verse) — exegeted as the souls (nefashot), via the wordplay mehalakh (walking/movement) = nefesh, souls that progress
tmp:2028: the opening of the gates of holiness — messianic result when the gate of the Sitra Achra (gate of Aram) falls its third time and Ben David builds the gates of kedushah
tmp:2029: 'ruach apeinu...' ('the breath of our nostrils,' Lam. 4:20) — proof-phrase for the two ruchot (spirits/breaths) encoded in ChaTaKh = twice 'ruach' (gematria of the acrostic of 'pote'ach et yadekha')
tmp:2030: the hands being opened and 'cut'/distinguished (nifta chin ve-nechtakhin) — the differentiation of right from left hand as the two ruchot, encoded in the acrostic ChaTaKh of Ps. 145:16
tmp:2031: melamdin alav zekhut — Heaven's advocacy/pleading of merit on behalf of the tzaddik in judgment (Berakhot 7b, 'he prevails in judgment'), the mechanism shielding him from the wicked's evil eye
tmp:2032: the tzaddik being saved from the evil eye (ra ayin) of the wicked — deliverance effected by God's own merit-finding for the rasha, removing judgment from the tzaddik
tmp:2033: self-judgment (mishpat) — the practice of a person judging and adjudicating himself over every deed before acting, the 'king through mishpat' that establishes fear/eretz
tmp:2034: being spared from the heavenly judgment (din shel ma'alah) — the exemption gained when one judges oneself below, so the court above need not judge him
tmp:2035: the perfection of da'at as the internalization of makkifim — transcendent surrounding lights (makkifim) becoming inner lights (penimiyim), completing the mind
tmp:2036: being saved from all troubles (nitzol mi-kol tzarot) — the protected state attained through perfected da'at, likened to escaping an ambusher by changing garments/face
tmp:2037: being saved from all of them (the three ambushers: wild beast, bandits, crossroads dangers) — deliverance via the three practices culminating in verbal confession before the talmid chakham
tmp:2038: tzedakah given to a Torah scholar — the specific charity-act that saves from the evil traits of the 'animal' and 'speaking' elements (wild beast = idle talk, bandits = pride)
tmp:2039: being saved from foreign thoughts (machshavot zarot) that confuse prayer ('the flood/mabbul') — protection gained by giving charity for the Land of Israel and being included in it
tmp:2040: being saved from adultery (ni'uf) and meriting shemirat ha-brit — sexual purity attained through humility (anavah), since arrogance leads to stumbling with a married woman (Sotah 4b)
tmp:2041: being saved from transgressions (averot) through giving tzedakah — compassion from Heaven grants da'at, and with da'at no 'spirit of folly' can lead one to sin
tmp:2042: being saved from the 'face of the Sitra Achra' — protection from the Other Side's countenance attained through tikkun ha-brit (rectified sexual covenant), which also rectifies niddah-blood/money-craving
tmp:2043: being saved from troubles (tzarot) by telling stories of tzaddikim — since confusion of mind is mochin de-katnut (constricted consciousness = judgments), and tzaddik-stories bring expanded mochin
tmp:2044: the act of giving ma'aser (the tithe) — the tenth-giving that invokes God's sheltering hand ('in the shadow of My hand I covered you') against enemies
tmp:2045: being saved from enemies/haters (son'im) — the divine protection of the pursued ('God seeks the nirdaf') secured through giving the tithe
tmp:2047: being saved from mikreh lailah (nocturnal seminal emission) — nocturnal purity achieved via perfection of the Holy Tongue (leshon ha-kodesh) with Targum, as with Elisha ('a holy man')
tmp:2048: 'lekhet' ('to walk,' from Micah 6:8 'hatznea lekhet') — exegeted as the sefirot Netzach and Hod (the two legs/full sukkah walls), paired with hatznea = Yesod
tmp:2050: the simple supernal light becoming configured (nitztayer) according to the receiving vessel — the tzeirei-vocalization principle that the undifferentiated light takes the shape of its kli
tmp:2051: the totality of the lower rung (klal ha-madregah ha-tachtonah) — the principle that any entire lower level is 'nefesh'/feminine relative to the rung above it
